title: 황록색
suno_analysis_sp: K-Pop Indie Pop track in G Major at 100 BPM. The arrangement features a clean, palm-muted electric guitar playing a rhythmic eighth-note pattern and a warm synth bass with a soft attack. A drum machine provides a steady backbeat with a crisp snare and a tight hi-hat. A female vocalist sings in a breathy, intimate tone with light reverb. Subtle synth pads provide harmonic texture in the background. The production is polished with a focus on vocal clarity and a minimalist rhythmic pocket.
